title: Recognize nonreduced multiplication tensors with explicit Frobenius transporters
body:
This closes the three-factor tensor-reconstruction handoff in PR #5502. The new regular-module criterion recognizes commutative unital multiplication from an arbitrary square prime-field tensor, including algebras with nilpotents. Composing the recovered table with the pinned Frobenius-truncated classifier returns the height list and explicit independent maps for both inputs and the output. Kappa is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/831b41da0fc09e3e4cb983c03662da5df7970f68/research/nonreduced-tensor-recognition/README.md), [exact checks](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/831b41da0fc09e3e4cb983c03662da5df7970f68/research/nonreduced-tensor-recognition/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/831b41da0fc09e3e4cb983c03662da5df7970f68/research/nonreduced-tensor-recognition/SOURCES.json), [registered replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/831b41da0fc09e3e4cb983c03662da5df7970f68/research/nonreduced-tensor-recognition/VERIFY.json). Base: canonical main `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`, priority revision 7. Contribution head: `831b41da0fc09e3e4cb983c03662da5df7970f68`.

The new condition tests the top of each local nucleus module modulo the nilpotent radical. Both modules must have one residue-field generator. Matching dimension and faithfulness alone are insufficient: the faithful dual module of F_p[x,y]/(x,y)^2 is an explicit rejecting control. The proof is necessary and sufficient and gives deterministic polynomial complexity at each fixed prime. It does not solve isomorphism of arbitrary recovered algebras.

CPython 3.12.14 warning-strict registered normal and optimized checks pass. All 256 binary 2x2x2 tensors agree with independent complete GL2-cubed orbit enumeration: 174 general commutative tensors and 54 Frobenius-truncated tensors. Forty additional presentations cover primes 2,3,5,7,13 and dimensions through nine. The checks verify 1736 literal transported basis products, 76 controls and three immutable source copies. Both modes print `PASS_NONREDUCED_TENSOR_RECOGNITION`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/nonreduced-tensor-recognition
```

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. Committed-byte checks pass. The pinned PR #5502 class theorem remains a credited premise; its complete prior scientific suite is not rerun. The new written proof has no independent human or proof-kernel acceptance. No extension-field input layer, variable-characteristic bit-complexity claim, selected cold replay, physical supplier or complete multiplication theorem is supplied. The optional full-history preflight could not run because this checkout is shallow; declared source bytes and the direct canonical-main base were checked separately. Hosted status is unconfirmed at publication.

Credit apoursh (@apoursh) for [PR #5502](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5502), its [pinned table classifier](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c09b7a57f81f941b7f9ee6882172eb21a683ded1/research/frobenius-algebra-recognition/recognize.py), [class proof](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c09b7a57f81f941b7f9ee6882172eb21a683ded1/research/frobenius-algebra-recognition/PROOF.md) and explicit reconstruction handoff. Credit Ali Romman (@aliromman) for [PR #5525](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5525) and its [pinned nucleus routines](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3d5f42dc084b8c9e1ad73318458751e851752a10/research/etale-tensor-recognition/recognize.py), and Nick Petalas (@petalas) for [PR #5252](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5252). Source copies retain the David Ganz, finite-algebra and atlas lineage. [Scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19174752).

Next: add an explicit extension-field contract that separates q-power decomposition from the semilinear p-power height flag, or apply the recovered heights to the pinned determinant-character formula. General recovered-algebra isomorphism and physical costs remain open.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
